headline: Visa vs PayPal: The Post Earnings Winner
summary: Visa crossed $4 trillion in global payments volume the same quarter PayPal brought in a new CEO to salvage branded checkout, and the two earnings reports could not paint a more different picture of where fintech power is actually concentrating.

headline: PayPal (PYPL) Joins Binance bStocks As Crypto Users Gain Stock Exposure
summary: Binance has added PayPal Holdings (NasdaqGS: PYPL) to its bStocks tokenized stock lineup. The move lets Binance users gain price exposure and economic benefits linked to PayPal stock without directly owning shares. The addition expands access to PayPal for international investors who operate primarily through digital asset platforms.
